invariants.rationale: The method collects non-null reduced values into a list; result is never null.
All values in 'result' are filtered to be non-null before collection.
Each key in the input data maps to exactly one output in result, and there cannot be more output elements than input.
If input is empty, result will be empty; non-empty input may still yield empty result only if all groups reduce to null, but this never happens due to non-null filter.
Parallel streams require parallelism to be positive by design intent.
